title: Helper9
summary: From a single-shot email-to-calendar AI prompt to an agentic family assistant with tools for multi-step tasks.
details: A hands-on exploration of agentic AI that grew over 18 months into a family organization app. The assistant can find, create, and update calendar events, check for duplicates, and coordinate work across multiple tools.

title: ESP32 Internet Radio
summary: An Instructables newsletter sparked a five-day experiment: building an ESP32 internet radio with ChatGPT and AWS IoT Core.
details: Inspired by a clever enclosure, I explored stereo audio, rechargeable power, and cloud-based controls. Within five days I had a working internet radio responding to MQTT commands, with a web frontend still to build.

title: New York Harbor HO Layout
summary: After 16 years without a layout, the model railroad bug is back. The shelf now has 19 car spots, and two locomotives are running again.
details: After building several layouts across four moves, I'm returning to model railroading with a portable HO waterfront switching layout featuring a car float, runaround, brick warehouses, and Peco Code 100 track.

title: My backlog of project ideas
summary: Projects I'm considering before they earn a spot on the bench.
details: A running list of ideas, starting with found-object robot sculptures.
